# Joel Theatrical Rigging

> > Professional theatrical rigging systems, equipment, and automation solutions for performing arts venues across Canada and beyond.

Joel Theatrical specializes in counterweight rigging, motorized stage automation (featuring Raynok Imperium consoles), pipe and tension grids, fall protection equipment from Peakworks, and custom theatrical installations. The company serves major venues including Massey Hall, Brock University, and the Elgin & Winter Garden Theatre in Toronto.

## Key Topics

- Counterweight rigging systems
- Motorized stage automation
- Raynok Imperium motion control
- Theatrical rigging equipment
- Fall protection and safety
- Pipe and tension grids
- Stage ropes (Multiline II composite)
- Peakworks safety equipment
- Loft blocks and sheaves
- Truss pipe battens
- Hoist control systems
- Orchestra pit safety nets
- Custom theatrical fabrication
- Performing arts venue installations
- Toronto theatrical projects

## Motorized Rigging & Automation

- [Raynok Imperium Motion Control Console](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/console-Raynok-imperium.html): Raynok Imperium motion control console for automated theatrical rigging
- [Pendant Pickle XLR-4 Hoist Control](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/pendant-Pickle-XLR-4.html): Pendant Pickle XLR-4 low voltage chain hoist control system
- [Console Imperium (French)](https://joeltheatrical.com/fr/produits/console-Raynok-imperium.html): Console d'automation Raynok Imperium pour gréage motorisé (French)

## Counterweight Rigging Systems

- [Multiline II Composite Stage Ropes](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/multiline-II_rope.html): Multiline II composite stage ropes for counterweight rigging systems
- [8 Inch Loft Block with Cast Iron Sheave](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/8-inch-Loft-Block-cast-iron-sheave.html): 8" cast iron loft block with 500 lb SWL for counterweight rigging
- [HD Truss Pipe Batten](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/HD-Truss-Pipe-Batten.html): Custom fabricated truss pipe battens with double 1.5" Sch 40 steel pipe
- [Poulie en fonte 8 pouces (French)](https://joeltheatrical.com/fr/produits/mouffle-fonte-8-pouces.html): Moufle en fonte de 8 pouces pour gréage par contrepoids (French)

## Pipe & Tension Grid Systems

- [Static Pipe Grid Systems](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/pipe-grid.html): Static pipe grid systems for TV studios and blackbox theatres
- [Pipe Clamps](https://joeltheatrical.com/products/pipe-clamp.html): Pipe clamps for theatrical rigging and tension grid systems
